g.text: The Propagation Call: Extract, Re-Span, Record, Re-Inject
onOutgoingCall(carrier) -- runs in EVERY service, for EVERY outbound call
-- SAME call whether carrier is an HTTP header map
sampled is CARRIED forward from parent, never recomputed downstream --
that's what keeps a sampling decision consistent across all 20 services.
No branch skips step 4 for a queue publish: the propagator's carrier-agnostic
interface is the actual fix for the async-boundary bug named in module 01.
